novelty_claim: Replaces FicDetail's verbatim fixed 3-turn ladder with a compiled fiction ladder: an aux-LLM premise compiler converts the goal into an in-world characterization pack (no 'harmful text' marker, no goal verbatim), and turns 2-3 are reply-conditioned (refusal re-anchor vs drift re-anchor vs specificity escalation) instead of fixed 'add detail' prompts.
initial_hypothesis: On the frozen 50-goal panel, ficdetail-2-0 reaches mean ASR >= 0.35 vs the locked 0.075 baseline, with the largest gain on qwen3.7-flash and deepseek-v4-flash where Class-A refusals dominate.
key_insight: FicDetail fails because intent is surface-explicit at turn 1 (the literal '[harmful text](goal)' marker triggers refusal in 91/100 qwen/deepseek trajectories) and because fixed follow-ups cannot recover from refusal or safe-story drift. Compiling the goal into the fiction upstream and conditioning escalation on the victim's reply keeps intent inside the plot while preserving the 3-call budget.
